newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Interport to launch rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Interport to launch rights issue.

text.p: The Philippines' Securities and Exchange Commission said it had allowed real estate firm Interport Resources Corp to offer a one-for-one rights issue.
Interport sought SEC approval early last year, but a squabble over the company's ownership made the SEC defer its decision, Interport president Manuel Recto told Reuters.
The SEC, in a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange, said the proceeds of the issue would be held in escrow under a special account.
Recto said he did not mind the condition. "Every time we need the money, we will just seek the approval of the SEC... There's no problem to it," he said.
The proceeds of the rights issue are expected to fund real estate development and administrative expenses.
